Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We don’t ship broadly worldwide right now.

• We currently ship within the contiguous United States, with limited availability to Alaska, Hawaii, and select regions in Canada. • We do not ship to other international locations outside the US and Canada.

For orders to Canada: • All required fees, duties, taxes, and certifications are already included in the prices and shipping charges shown at checkout. • There are no additional customs fees you need to pay on delivery, and you do not need to obtain your own phytosanitary certificate.

If you tell me what country you’re in, I can confirm whether shipping is available to your specific area or if Canada/US might work for you as a ship-to destination.

turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

For most orders, shipping is pretty quick, but it depends a bit on where you are and what you chose at checkout.

• United States (contiguous states): Transit time is typically about 1–5 business days once your order ships. • Alaska & Hawaii: Transit can be a bit longer than the 1–5 day window. • Canada (eligible regions): You choose a ship week at checkout; orders usually arrive the following week after that ship week.

At checkout, you’ll see a delivery calendar where you can pick an estimated arrival date (US) or ship week (Canada). Those options already factor in our processing time plus typical carrier transit time for your location.

turns.replyText:
What's your return and refund policy?

Hi, here’s our return and refund policy:

• Gardening tools and other hard goods can be returned within 30 days of delivery if they’re in new, unused condition. • Opened or used merchandise is not eligible for return, except gloves, which may be returned opened if they’re still in the original packaging. • Return shipping costs are the customer’s responsibility. • Tags and stakes are non-returnable because each one is custom engraved.

• Fertilizers, soil amendments, beneficial insects, and plant treatments are final sale and are not covered by warranty.

For live plants: • Roses are not returnable, but they are covered by a one-year guarantee. • Perennials are not returnable, but they are covered by a 90-day guarantee. • Bulbs are not returnable, but they are covered by a failure-to-bloom guarantee.

If a warranty claim is approved for eligible plants, you’ll receive store credit valid for one year.

You can read the full policy here: Our Guarantee

If you want, I can also break it down for a specific item you’re considering or already ordered.
